rendered:
According to the text, the 10% Mn-doped LNO sample generated 901.4 J g^−1 of heat, while the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample generated 485.7 J g^−1 of heat. To find out how much more heat the 10% Mn-doped LNO sample released, we need to subtract the heat generated by the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample from the heat generated by the 10% Mn-doped LNO sample.

Heat released by 10% Mn-doped LNO - Heat released by 50% Mn-doped LNO
= 901.4 J g^−1 - 485.7 J g^−1
= 415.7 J g^−1
